condition: Non-valvular Atrial Fibrillation with Stroke Risk
inclusion_criteria: Confirmed diagnosis of non-valvular atrial fibrillation for at least 6 months
Willing to undergo 14-day washout from current anticoagulant
Adequate hepatic function (ALT and AST less than 3x upper limit of normal)
exclusion_criteria: Active bleeding or known bleeding disorder
Concurrent use of strong CYP3A4 inducers including but not limited to rifampin, St. John's Wort, carbamazepine, phenytoin
Concurrent use of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors including but not limited to ketoconazole, itraconazole, ritonavir
Participation in another interventional clinical trial within 60 days of screening
Known hypersensitivity to direct factor Xa inhibitors
Uncontrolled hypertension (systolic > 180 mmHg or diastolic > 110 mmHg)
Planned invasive procedure during study period
primary_endpoint: Incidence of major and clinically relevant non-major bleeding events at Week 12
pharmacology_notes: Vorixaban is primarily metabolized via CYP3A4. Strong inducers significantly reduce plasma concentration, potentially leading to therapeutic failure.
